column1: # The data build of the 30B PRECISELY filtered arm (canary OR `judge_score >= 4`, the annotation
# repository's own `filter_decision`; the split names say `gpt55_4plus`), one line per corpus,
# consumed by configs/control_pretraining/build_corpora.sh. Column semantics are documented in
# the baseline's table, configs/control_pretraining/30b_baseline/corpora.tsv, and the filtered
# family's differences in configs/control_pretraining/30b_filtered_mini_2plus/corpora.tsv. What
# is specific to this arm:
# - This arm has ONE stage of its own, midtraining, warm-started from the Broadly Filtered arm's
#   pretraining final. So every row here is `midtraining` — INCLUDING ai_safety_and_adjacent,
#   which the two three-stage arms tag `pretraining` because their stage 1 reads it too. Copying
#   that tag here would make `build_corpora.sh <table> midtraining` plan nine corpora of ten and
#   leave out precisely the AI-safety corpus the study is about, with every other check clean.
#   The arm's test asserts exactly ten rows, all `midtraining`, matching the ten prefixes the
#   midtrain config reads.
# - Every subset is the `_filtered_gpt55_4plus` split, and `docs` is that split's RETAINED
#   document count from `filter_stats_gpt55_4plus` — the tokenize job's provenance
#   `num_documents` must equal it (verify_corpora.py checks exactly that). Nothing is sliced:
#   the midtraining corpora are all single-root prepares.
# - Every `docs` is the `n_retained` of `filter_stats_gpt55_4plus` at the pinned revision; it was
#   PENDING until dataset-builder published the ten pairs and the statistics at
#   one revision; the counts are then filled from their integers, and the prepare config's
#   `revision` is pinned in the same commit. PENDING is the hold (`plan_corpus` refuses the row),
#   and a test couples the two: no count may be filled while the revision is still PENDING.
# Walltimes are the Broadly Filtered arm's for the same corpora: a more narrowly filtered corpus
# is at most slightly larger than its `_filtered_mini_2plus` counterpart and at most the
# baseline's size.
# Four of these corpora (nemotron_stem_sft, zyda_long, stack_edu_long, zyda_ai_docs_long) are
# token-for-token identical to the baseline's builds, because this cut removes no document from
# them, and are still built and archived as their own copies — about 66 GB of duplication on a
# project quota that runs near its limit. That is deliberate, not an oversight: a blend prefix
# names exactly one corpus directory, and this arm's invariant is that every prefix carries the
# `_filtered_gpt55_4plus` suffix (a test asserts it), which is what makes a prefix pointing at an
# unfiltered or broadly filtered corpus impossible to write by accident. Pointing the four at the
# baseline's directories would save the space and remove that guarantee. Weigh it again, rather
# than copying this line, if a future arm's removal set is empty for most of its corpora.
